source_revision_note: Git SHA is the baseline worktree commit. Production candidate is bound by the immutable source archive and actual binary SHA; root owns final commit/push. The last edit after compilation only isolates standalone ifup /run state in the test harness.

environment.virtualization: QEMU TCG, 1536 MiB, 4 vCPUs; disposable Linux namespaces, actual DHCP/PPP/DHCPv6 and forwarded HTTP. Synthetic ISP services; no physical ISP or host NIC bridging.

scope_notes: The 62 final matrix groups cover standalone static, Static/DHCP, DHCP/Static, DHCP/DHCP, DHCP/PPPoE, PPPoE/DHCP, PPPoE/PPPoE and initially absent PPP-primary/DHCP-backup with IPv6/PD.

Each dual case proves distinct HTTP egress markers, carrier loss/restoration, carrier-up upstream blackhole, no false primary recovery through backup, both-down fail-closed and unchanged saved configuration bytes.
IPv6 remains primary-only: backup withdraws primary PD addresses and IPv6 authorization; primary recovery reacquires a changed prefix with stable identity.

The focused 13-group test used initial harness a7771b89; the full 62-group matrix used final c5886069, whose only subsequent fix isolates standalone ifup state in private /run. Production sources, release binary and ISO did not change.
CLI nobody regression accepts public DHCP export (exit 0) and rejects backup PPP credential export (exit 1); dummy credentials were never printed.
Actual GUI/reboot/cold-boot/256 MiB appliance proof, independent review, Git remote and hosted CI are owned separately by root; not inferred from this packet suite.

prior_failures.reason: Standalone ifup shared /run/ifstate from earlier r3 namespace. Fixed test-only by giving standalone activation fresh private /run; no runtime/compiler/ISO input changed. Existing global ifstate wan0=wan0 was retained while fixed static case passed.

prior_failures.cause: Strict reverse-path filtering rejected bound probe replies before main default selection. Causal private-lab control isolated rp_filter; core fixed rendered dual-WAN sysctl.

dhcpcd -6 -x with no master started a default-config daemon and blocked later PPP PD. Empty-private-run reproduction plus guarded-stop diagnostic confirmed cause; core r4 uses verified same-netns PID lifecycle and bounded signals.
